name: strudel-studio
title: Strudel Studio
description: A live-coding music studio: write Strudel and play it on skeuomorphic hardware generated from the code's syntax tree — a rack of modules with LED-ring knobs, channel faders, backlit mute/solo pads and TR-style step keys on a masonry grid you drag and resize. Every control rewrites the code while it plays; a syntax-tree tab shows the parsed song. Four starter songs.
